newsitem.title: USA: Steelworkers to meet with WHX Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Steelworkers to meet with WHX Thursday.

text.p: The United Steelworkers union said Tuesday in a brief statement that it scheduled a meeting with WHX Corp for Thursday.

Further details were not provided, but a company spokesman said a time and place had not yet been designated. He said the meeting was between senior officials from both sides and would not include full negotiating committees.
Some 4,500 workers have been on strike against WHX since October 1 over a pension plan dispute.
Contract talks were last held in January, but broke off abruptly after the two sides could not reach an agreement on pensions.
The union is asking for a defined benefit plan, while the company wants to enhance its defined contribution plan.
"(The meeting) certainly lends itself to a restart of talks, but where it goes from there is anybody's guess," the spokesman said.
